newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end higher on finance, bank buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end higher on finance, bank buying.

text.p: Thai stocks closed higher in active trade on Thursday with blue chip finance and bank issues leading the advance, brokers said.
The SET index finished up 11.11 points, or 1.13 percent, at 990.62 on 8.24 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index rose 1.18 points to 76.69.
"The market saw strong buying of finance and bank shares in the afternoon. Most of the buying came from foreign investors," said one broker at Wall Street Finance.
Winners led losers 191 to 133 with 104 closed unchanged.

Bangkok Bank, Thailand's largest bank, surged six baht to end at 210 on heavy 256 million baht turnover. The bank's gain followed an announcement on Thursday of its 9.9 percent third quarter profit rise.
Analysts said Bangkok Bank's profit was in line with market expectations and reflected its prudent lending policy.
Dhana Siam topped the active list, easing 0.50 baht to 85.
